title: Credit Controller
description:
Join a well-established Poole-based retail organisation as a Credit Controller. Known for a friendly and dynamic culture, our client prides itself on their commitment to quality and team development. Conveniently located in Poole, Dorset with easy access and a professional but relaxed work environment, this company values punctuality, staff engagement, and continuous learning. This role offers an immediate start, flexible hours in the mornings, and a chance to be part of a reputable retail sector leader.

What will the Credit Controller role involve?
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely and accurate processing of sales invoices and receipts, contributing to smooth financial operations
- Engaging with customers via email and phone to facilitate collections and resolve account queries, supporting cash flow targets
- Collaborating with internal teams to ensure billing accuracy and efficient account management, fostering strong stakeholder relationships
- Assisting with basic financial analysis and reporting, helping to optimise collection strategies
- Maintaining meticulous records, adhering to company policies, and supporting continuous process improvement initiatives

Suitable Candidate for the Credit Controller vacancy:
- Proven experience in sales ledger, credit control, or accounts receivable functions, ideally within retail or a similar sector
- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with a confident telephone manner
- Strong organisational skills with attention to detail and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively
- Proficient with Excel; training on company-specific software will be provided
- Positive attitude, punctuality, and the desire to learn and develop within a finance role

Additional benefits and information for the role of Credit Controller:
- Flexible working hours in the morning to suit your routinea

- Opportunities to gain experience in credit control and finance operations within a thriving retail business
- Salary will be dependent on experience

title: Night Order Processor / Administrator
description:
Night Order Processor / Administrator

Location: Poole, Dorset
Job Type: Permanent
Salary:£25,272 per annum / £13.50 per hour
Hours:36 hours per week - 4 nights

Shift Pattern:
- Monday:9.00pm - 6.00am
- Tuesday:9.00pm - 6.00am
- Thursday:9.00pm - 6.00am
- Friday:7.00pm - 6.00am

30-minute unpaid break per shift.

We are recruiting a Night Order Processor / Administrator to join a well-established food distribution company based in Poole.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration, order processing or data entry experience who enjoys working in a busy environment. Accuracy is particularly important, as you will be responsible for processing customer orders received by voicemail and email ready for the following day's operation.

- Accurately entering customer orders onto the company's computer system.
- Listening to voicemail orders and interpreting information accurately.
- Processing orders received by email.
- Maintaining accurate records and filing systems.
- Carrying out general administration, scanning and document preparation.
- Assisting with customer price lists.
- Responding to queries from the night production team.
- Ensuring orders and administration are completed within required deadlines.
- Providing additional administrative support when required.

The Ideal Candidate

Previous experience within administration, order processing, data entry or customer service would be ideal.

You should have:
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel.
- Strong data entry and numerical skills.
- Excellent listening and communication skills.
- The ability to work efficiently and independently during night hours.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- The ability to prioritise workloads in a fast-paced environment.
- A reliable and professional approach.
- The ability to learn new computer systems quickly.

What's on Offer
- £25,272 per annum / £13.50 per hour.
- Permanent position.
- 36-hour, four-night working week.
- Only four shifts per week.
- Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday nights off.
- Established and successful local employer.
- Varied administration and order processing position.

To apply for this permanent opportunity, please submit your latest CV and we will be in touch in due course. Alternatively, please contact Alan, Nikola or Anita for further information.

title: Payroll Clerk
company: McGinnis Loy Associates Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Payroll Clerk / Payroll Advisor - SUPERB ROLE

McGinnis Loy Associates is proud to be working with a highly regarded Top 20 Accountancy Firm who are continuing to enjoy strong growth across the South West and South Coast region. They are now seeking a Payroll Administrator / Payroll Clerk to join their growing team in Poole who will be responsible for multiple client payrolls consisting of UK Ltd companies & partnerships. Reporting to the Payroll Manager, key duties include:
- Processing 30-50 client payrolls per month for third party employees on a weekly, fortnightly and/or monthly basis
- Calculating PAYE, NI, SSP, SMP, SPP and other payments on behalf of clients (eg student loans, travel loans, expense payments)
- Reconciling client payrolls and ensuring all payrolls processed are accurate and on time
- Calculating statutory maternity/paternity pay, sick pay and holiday pay entitlements for clients
- Setting up new payroll schemes for clients, supporting them through the first few payroll cycles
- Dealing with all client, employee and HMRC payroll queries
- Maintaining accurate employee records and checking payroll updates and their input through the system
- Ensuring all pay slips are processed and managing the submission of pay slip files
- Processing End Of Year client payrolls in accordance with client contracts and HMRC guidelines (P45s, P46s, P38s etc)
- Reconciliation of client monies and undertaking audits for data quality

To be considered for the role you should have hands-on experience working in a multi-client payroll environment, up to date knowledge of UK payroll regulations, year-end processes and UK payroll rules. You will be personally responsible for 30-50 client payrolls so you should have strong attention to detail, able to spot discrepancies, manage competing payroll deadlines, be confident communicating directly with clients and be able to work in a fast-paced payroll environment. Experience of working in another Accounting Firm or a Payroll Bureau would be a distinct advantage, as would expertise with different payroll systems such as PayCircle, Xero, Star Payroll etc.

On offer is a base salary to £31,000 depending on relevant experience, healthcare & pension schemes, 25 days holiday and other flexible benefits. To apply for the position, or for more information, please contact McGinnis Loy Associates (Reading) Office by telephone or via email. McGinnis Loy Associates Ltd is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy, in accordance with the Employment Agencies Act

title: ESR Administrator
company: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for a proactive and highly motivated ESR Administrator to join our team during an exciting period of growth, innovation and preparation for the future workforce solution. We are dedicated to enhancing and expanding the ESR system and services we provide to all staff at Dorset HealthCare University Foundation Trust. As the primary workforce management system used across the NHS, ESR plays a pivotal role in our operations. By joining our team, you will contribute to driving positive change within the trust, helping us deliver improved services and support to all employees. The ideal candidate will have previous experience with ESR. As an ESR Administrator you will provide essential support to our staff by managing access and training needs via the service desk, maintaining, reporting, and reviewing accounts, roles, work structure's and data quality within ESR. Please note visa sponsorship for this role is unfortunately not available. Ensure you hold valid right to work in the UK and will not require sponsorship if successful. You will play a key role in delivering and maintaining Manager, Administrator, Supervisor and Employee Self-Service. Optimising existing system functionalities, and implementing new features and functionality across various departments and teams. The role of ESR Administrator will include providing training needs and ongoing support to all staff and their use of Self-Service, and working cooperatively and maintaining close working relationships with our other trusts departments, particularly HR, Payroll, Finance and Rostering. It is essential that you have excellent IT Skills, including Microsoft Office, Teams and Outlook. Previous experience of ESR and Self-Service is desirable but not essential as full training will be provided. You must be methodical, organised, and work to a high standard with a flexible approach and understanding of the need to respond/deliver work across a diverse area within tight timescales. The role is based at our Dorset HealthCare HQ site in Poole and a weekly presence is required on site. There may also be the need for occasional travel to our other sites around Dorset. The post holder may be required to work flexibly to meet the needs of the service. For the main duties and responsibilities for this role please read the attached job description and person specification. When completing your application please ensure your supporting statement reflects the criteria set out in these documents by showing how your experience and skills apply to this post. We understand that AI can be a useful tool when completing your application. However, we are seeing an increasing over-reliance of AI tools, which can negatively affect your application as it reduces a candidates individuality, and makes it difficult for us to gain a clear and authentic understanding of your experience, skills, and in turn your suitability for the role. All submissions must be truthful and if you do use AI, it should only be used to enhance your application and not create your supporting statement in its entirety. Your supporting statement should be in your own words and must accurately reflect your personal experience and achievements. Where we have concerns that AI has been used to generate content that misrepresents your experience and suitability for the role, we may withdraw your application. As part of our vision to have a skilled, diverse and caring workforce, Dorset HealthCare offers support for people getting into work. We offer an employability service to support individuals with application writing, interview skills and other employment support. If you would like or know of anyone who would value this support, please do contact dhc.wideningparticipation@nhs.net
